name: hooded_blades
description: Hooded dual-blade duellist: explosive dashes, overhead and rising cuts, a back-jump, a spin, a launch to an apex hit and a blade orbit. Rig Forge rig.

keyframes._note: bd: near blade pulled down-back (keeps the wind-up behind the body)
LOAD: lean back, near blade cocked behind head (drawn under it)
breakdown: blade overhead, far arm pulls back
CONTACT: full-reach lunge, blade stretched (reach exaggeration)
COIL: deep crouch, blade crossed low in front
CONTACT: up on the toes, blade straight up-back, far blade counters low-forward
APEX: tucked knees, blades flung wide (spread X)
WIND: chest twisted away, both blades back
1/4: near blade swings at the camera (foreshortened)
3/4: back to camera, near blade behind
1 1/4: near blade at the camera again
CONTACT: wide stance, near blade at full reach
LOAD: deepest crouch, blades low behind
LAUNCH: one straight vertical line, blades up
APEX HIT: flying knee, blades crossed forward-up / up-back
FLING: arms snap open, blades leave the hands
CATCH: wide stance, forward blade up, reverse-grip blade back
